cost_of_equity.description: Cost of equity, annual decimal fraction.

debt_to_equity.description:
Target debt-to-equity ratio D/E, decimal, not negative. Give exactly one of
`debt_to_equity` and `debt_weight`.

debt_weight.description:
Target weight of debt D/(D + E), decimal fraction from 0 to below 1. Give exactly one of
`debt_to_equity` and `debt_weight`.

pre_tax_cost_of_debt.description: Pre-tax cost of debt, annual decimal fraction.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate of the tax shield, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1.
